text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe-san! About the next mock race, I'd 
like to talk—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hold up!! It might be better...
not to 
do that right now.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That face says, "I have no particular 
reason, but I'm in a foul mood today"... 
Best let sleeping kings lie, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that right!? I see...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Sion-san! You really know 
a lot about Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm not really sure about that. 
Haha...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—You there. I am bored. Entertain your 
King.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? M-Me!? Entertain you? What am I 
supposed to do...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Is it not the duty of the common folk to 
ponder such things?
Must I truly spell out 
every single detail for you to understand?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... another victim... Ugh. I gotta be 
careful, or I'll end up like that too, 
ssus...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Have you seen Orfevre? I need 
to collect her math worksheet...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I haven't seen it, but... ah.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's raining, so she's probably in the 
committee room. Journey-san, that is.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You know how Orfe-san hates humidity, 
right? Over there, they've got a 
dehumidifier.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Thank you for the advice, it 
really helped.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I gave Orfe a potion and he said it 
tasted gross! What is his problem?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san... please calm down and listen. 
—We're just going to have to be the
bigger 
person here.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If anything, it's amazing... She wouldn't 
drink anything made by someone she 
dislikes. It's proof she respects you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, really?
Not that that means I'm gonna 
forgive you, though!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, you know a lot about Orfe, don't 
you? From now on,
you're the one in charge 
of dealing with her!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
academy, I spotted Win Variation looking 
somewhat melancholy.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san. Actually—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Shion-san! It's "The One Who 
Understands Orfevre," Shion-san!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Before I knew it, people started 
calling me that... and just the other day—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It seems they've taken to calling you
'the 
one who understands Us.'

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...S-So what if it is?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well, you are permitted. There must 
be someone to proclaim the way of the
King 
to the masses, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Keep striving.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......No,
I'm not gonna work hard at that! 
Why on earth would I have to strive for 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not like I wanted to become an 
expert in the first place. It's just—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Because it was so dazzling. I just 
couldn't take my eyes off it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...'Cause you've always been right in 
front of me. Right where I'm aiming to go.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
And what's more, shining brighter than 
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
How could I not keep my eyes glued to 
that?! Of course I'd end up knowing all 
about it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......Ngh, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to 
complain like that...!
choice_data_list: You've patiently hung in there rig...
You've patiently hung in there rig...
It's amazing you kept on learning ...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......Ngh, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to 
complain like that...!
choice_data_list: You've tenaciously kept up with th...
You've tenaciously kept up with th...
It's admirable that you kept study...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. That was... all I could do...
choice_data_list: You've tenaciously kept up with th...
You've tenaciously kept up with th...
It's admirable that you kept study...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's just, the result of that being... 
that, um— I'm Orfe-san's "one who 
understands her"...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaah!
It's still bugging me after all! 
Geez!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Having you evaluate me like that
makes 
me really happy. Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's only natural. —In order to 
win.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I just put in the necessary effort, so. 
Yeah... I'll keep doing my best from now 
on.
